title: Work and Calling
definition: Work and Calling is serving God faithfully in the responsibilities, assignments, and opportunities He gives in ordinary life.
summary: Work and Calling is serving God faithfully in the responsibilities, assignments, and opportunities He gives in ordinary life.
christFocus: Jesus dignifies faithful service, calls His people to follow Him, and receives work done unto Him rather than for human praise.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Calling is not limited to public ministry or platform. Scripture teaches that ordinary work, service, caregiving, endurance, and faithfulness can be offered to God.

Believers are created in Christ for good works. God gives different responsibilities in different seasons, and faithfulness matters even when work is unseen.

Jesus calls people to follow Him in the real places where they live. The Spirit helps believers serve with integrity, humility, and purpose.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people feel unusable because disability, recovery, age, poverty, or life circumstances limit what they can do. Work and calling reminds them that Christ gives purpose beyond worldly measures of productivity.

This doctrine also challenges ambition that seeks identity in achievement. Calling belongs to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Offer your current responsibilities to Jesus. Serve faithfully where you are, reject comparison, and ask the Spirit to show how your life can glorify God in this season.
